messages:
Tess H: Heads-up: small-team sprint to produce a compact enterprise solution brief (1-pager + webinar 3-bullet bench) aimed at security-conscious buyers. Need field-ready CTAs and inbound routing rules.
Diego P: I'll sketch the page layout and hero line. Thinking: hero = 'Secure inference, production SLAs, deploy how you need.' Short, brand-forward.
Nina K: Add compliance line for healthcare and financial services. One-liner for each: Healthcare = 'PHI-safe by design'; FinServ = 'Audit-ready controls & KMS.'
Omar G: Bench bullets we can reuse from recent run: median p95 latency = 120ms on Dedicated-8, throughput = 2k tokens/s sustained, approx cost = $45 per 1M tokens (quantized fp16-8bit configs). Will attach measurement notes.
Tess H: Inbound routing note: enterprise leads (industry in ["healthcare","finance"]) and MQL>=80 -> route to AE enterprise queue, Slack notify @ae-enterprise and email 1: AE oncall + 15m SLA.
Diego P: Design ask: include a small "Talking Points" box with 3 counters for security, cost, and migration effort.
design-bot: Generated layout variants: https://designs.redwood/briefs/ent-pocket-v3 (use variant B)
Nina K: Also include a short FAQ: "Can you host on-prem?" answer: "Yes 1 private deployment with HSM/KMS and audit logs."
Omar G: Also suggest adding: "Fallback model variant preserves availability; configurable caching reduces token cost by up to 40%."
Tess H: OK team: Diego finalize copy, Omar add bench footnote link, Nina add compliance bullets + FAQ, I'll export and prep webinar slide. Target = EOD. :white_check_mark:
